近红外表示约 700–1100 纳米的感光波段，对尘埃更不敏感；画面采用暖色伪彩: Near infrared covers approximately 700–1100 nanometres and is less affected by dust. Warm false colour makes this invisible band visible; it is not an unaided-eye view. A nanometre is one billionth of a metre.
暗适应让更暗的恒星可见，并降低暗弱星光的色彩饱和度，模拟视杆细胞主导的暗视觉。: Dark adaptation reveals fainter stars and reduces colour saturation in weak starlight, approximating vision dominated by rod cells.
裸眼模式采用较低的暗星阈值和较完整的亮星色彩，模拟尚未充分暗适应的视觉。: The unaided-eye mode shows fewer faint stars while retaining colour in brighter stars, approximating vision before full dark adaptation.

行星模式下，镜头保持当地竖直方向，银河带随行星地平朝向呈现相应倾斜；进入无大气模: In a planetary environment the camera stays locally upright, so the Milky Way tilts with the horizon orientation. Without atmosphere, the direction above the galactic disc defines up.
银河坐标网格表示以银河中心坐标轴为基准的经纬角线，只帮助判断视线方向，不表示恒星: The galactic coordinate grid shows angular directions relative to the galactic-centre coordinate axes. It is an orientation guide, not stars or galactic light.
沉浸增强只提高相机画面的色彩分离和局部对比度，不改变天体位置、距离、星数、银河宽: Enhancement increases colour separation and local contrast in camera views. It does not change object positions, distances, star counts, galactic width or dust extinction.
深空观测影像来自欧洲南方天文台、哈勃望远镜及巡天项目，只在可见光相机模式显示。辨: Deep-sky photographs come from ESO, Hubble and sky surveys and appear only in visible-light camera mode. Optional enlargement makes small images easier to recognise without changing the physical model. Turn it off to restore calculated angular sizes.
用于调节屏幕上的星光亮度。每增加 1 级，显示前的线性星光信号加倍；越大越亮，也: Adjusts displayed starlight. Each added stop doubles the linear signal before display. Higher values are brighter but can lose highlight detail. This is not a physical shutter time.
行星地平面相对银河盘的倾斜角，单位为度，没有优劣之分。它改变哪些天体位于地平线上: The horizon’s tilt relative to the galactic disc, in degrees. It changes which objects are above the horizon. Unlike camera elevation, it rotates the planetary frame while keeping the camera direction fixed. This is an imagined planetary environment, not a location on Earth.
当地恒星高度表示照亮行星大气的恒星相对地平线的角度；负值在地平线下，正值在地平线: The altitude of the star illuminating the atmosphere, measured from the horizon. Negative values are below it; positive values are above. Atmospheric scattering determines night, twilight and daylight.
当地恒星方位表示光源沿地平线一周的方向，单位为度；它决定暮光与日光在天空哪一侧最: The light source’s direction around the horizon, in degrees. It determines which side of the sky has the strongest twilight or daylight.
点击坐标会移动观察者，暂停并重置时间。朝向保持不变；开启中心锁定时，朝向会持续跟: Selecting coordinates moves the observer and pauses and resets time. Your direction stays the same unless centre tracking is enabled.
坐标依次为横向、纵向、垂直方向，单位都是秒差距。1 秒差距约为 3.26 光年；: Coordinates are X, Y and Z, all in parsecs. One parsec is approximately 3.26 light-years. Signs indicate direction; larger absolute values mean greater distance from the corresponding coordinate plane.

银河中心为坐标原点。横向负方向指向太阳，纵向位于银河盘面内，垂直正方向朝银河盘上: The galactic centre is the origin. Negative X points toward the Sun, Y lies in the galactic plane, and positive Z points above the disc. The distance below is the straight-line distance to the galactic centre.
银河盘面位置图；点击或拖动观察者点可连续改变位置: Galactic position map; click or drag the observer marker to move continuously
保持当前银河方位不变，沿银河中心与观察者连线连续移动。恒星方向与距离随滑杆实时变: Move along the line between the galactic centre and the observer while preserving galactic azimuth. Stellar directions and distances update continuously; dust and background light update in the background. Repositioning resets simulation time.
银河方位表示观察者绕银河中心所处的角度，决定站在哪里；它与观察方位不同，后者只决: Galactic azimuth describes your position around the centre; viewing azimuth describes where you look. Angles are in degrees. Current orbital speed:
千米/秒，方向由三维速度分量共同决定。: km/s, with direction set by the three velocity components.
视点移动造成的方向变化称为视差：附近恒星会明显改写原有星座形状，遥远星系只会轻微: A change in direction caused by observer motion is parallax. Nearby stars reshape familiar constellations; distant galaxies shift only slightly. Centaurus A is a galaxy about 3.8 million parsecs away, not a nearby star in Centaurus. Moving roughly 3,200 parsecs inward from the Sun usually shifts it by less than about 0.05°.
当前画面不是空白占位，也不声称是完整真值。实测星点与模型推断分别标记；三维恒星密: The view combines measured stars and model predictions; it is not a complete ground truth. Three-dimensional stellar density and dust shape the Milky Way’s brightness, width and dark lanes. Small-scale dust variations use a fixed statistical 3D model, not measured cloud positions.
耶鲁亮星表补足 6.5 星等以内的最亮恒星；Gaia 第三批数据提供 6.5 至: Yale supplies the brightest stars up to magnitude 6.5. Gaia DR3 adds stars from magnitude 6.5 to 8.5; smaller magnitudes are brighter. The sample with full six-dimensional phase space contains
。六维相空间表示三个位置分量与三个速度分量。: . Six-dimensional phase space means three position and three velocity components.
个恒星族群示踪点；银河盘、厚盘、棒、核球与核星盘连续辐射场。: stellar-population tracers, plus continuous emission fields for the thin disc, thick disc, bar, bulge and nuclear stellar disc.
个统计背景星系；距离、角大小和银河尘埃随视点重算。: statistical background galaxies. Distances, angular sizes and Milky Way dust are recalculated from the observer’s position.
个天文观测影像；三张改用完整宽视场照片，图幅与朝向按来源说明投影。照片色彩不代表: astronomical photographs. Three use wide-field images with extent and orientation based on their source documentation. Their colours do not represent unaided-eye vision.
远离太阳的单颗恒星身份、螺旋臂细节和全银河尘埃小尺度结构；属于统计近似，尚未完成: Individual distant-star identities, spiral-arm details and small-scale dust throughout the Milky Way remain statistical approximations. Full-galaxy calibration is incomplete; specific constellations are not guaranteed.

银河光采用分段发光与吸收的解析积分，计入光源所在分段自身的尘埃遮挡。视点和恒星运: Galactic light uses analytic emission and absorption integration within each segment, including dust in the source’s own segment. Observer and stellar motion are reprojected continuously. While dust and background light are being calculated, the latest result remains visible with an update indicator.
行星地景独立于银河盘，远景与近地面共同使用相机射线投影。地貌是艺术素材，不是指定: The planetary landscape is independent of the galactic disc. Distant terrain and nearby ground use the same camera-ray projection. The terrain is artistic material, not measured topography of a specified planet.
连续银河光、点源亮度和大气仍是可视化近似；没有完成统一绝对测光标定、恒星样本完备: Continuous galactic light, point-source brightness and atmosphere remain visual approximations. Unified absolute photometric calibration, stellar-sample completeness calibration and rigorous removal of overlap between resolved and unresolved light are incomplete. Stellar motion uses linear extrapolation, whose errors may grow over time.

当前版本已经能生成物理来源明确的银河天幕，但完整生产声明仍需要银河旋转曲线、星数: The sky has identifiable physical sources, but a full production claim still requires joint validation against the galactic rotation curve, star counts, all-sky brightness near the Sun, inner-galaxy infrared counts and dust posterior samples. 星等衡量天体亮度，数值越小越亮，可以为负值。这里显示: Magnitude measures brightness: smaller values are brighter and may be negative. The catalogue value shown uses the
的目录值，不是当前画面的显示亮度。不同波段的星等不能直接比较。: , not the brightness of the displayed image. Magnitudes in different bands cannot be compared directly.
光谱类型按恒星光谱特征分类；上方保留源表的字母和数字写法，是类别，不是优劣评分。: Spectral type classifies a star’s spectrum. Original letters and numbers are preserved above; they are categories, not quality scores.
温度单位为开尔文，越大表示越热；: Temperature is in kelvin; higher means hotter.
此值由恒星颜色估算，不是直接温度测量。: This value is estimated from stellar colour, not a direct temperature measurement.
源于目录温度或颜色估计，当前精简文件未保留二者的逐星区分。: This comes from a catalogue temperature or colour estimate; the compact sample does not preserve which method was used for each star.
运动依据实测位置与速度外推。精简文件未保存官方恒星编号，本地样本序号不能作为官方: Motion is extrapolated from measured positions and velocities. Official Gaia source IDs are absent from the compact file; local sample numbers are not official identifiers.
这颗星的位置和目录亮度有观测依据，动画中的速度来自族群模型，不能当作该星的实测运: Position and catalogue brightness are based on observations. The animation’s velocity comes from a population model, not this star’s measured motion.
光年是光在一年中传播的距离。下列数值越大表示越远，没有优劣之分；参考距离从太阳附: A light-year is the distance light travels in one year. Reference distance is measured from near the Sun; current distance is measured from your observing position. Larger values mean farther away.
照片是从太阳附近观测得到的二维图像，当前三维穿行中的内部形态仍是近似。照片中的星: This is a two-dimensional photograph observed from near the Sun. Its internal appearance during three-dimensional travel is still an approximation. Stars within the photo do not each have a loaded catalogue record.
此天体采用目录参数绘制简化轮廓，当前没有绑定观测照片。: This object uses a simplified outline from catalogue parameters; no observational photograph is attached.

依巴谷星表编号可以写成“依巴谷 32349”或“HIP 32349”；亨利·德雷: Use “HIP 32349” for a Hipparcos identifier or “HD 48915” for a Henry Draper identifier. Letters name the catalogue; numbers identify stars, not their brightness or distance. Chinese catalogue names also work.
盖亚数据没有保存官方恒星编号，只能用本地的“盖亚样本 123”等写法查找。也支持: Official Gaia source IDs are absent from this sample. Use a local identifier such as “Gaia sample 123”. Nebulae, clusters and galaxies can also be found by name or Messier identifier, such as M42 for the Orion Nebula.

这里是正式的观星平台。这份简短引导会带你认识朝向、位置、时间和天体查询；任何时候: This short guide introduces direction, position, time and object search. Skip it at any point and reopen it later with the Tutorial button.
左侧“银河中心”“银河外围”等按钮只转动视线，不移动观察位置。平时按住天幕拖动可: “Galactic centre” and “Outer galaxy” on the left turn the camera without moving you. Drag the sky to look around; scroll or use the field-of-view slider to zoom.
这些预设坐标会真正移动观察者。也可以拖动下面的银河位置图和距离滑杆。跳转会暂停并: Presets move the observer. You can also drag the galactic map or distance slider. A jump pauses and resets time, then recalculates stellar directions and brightness from your new position.
打开中心锁定后，跳转位置或播放时间都会持续看向银河中心，仍可缩放。关闭时停留在当: Centre tracking keeps the camera aimed at the galactic centre while you move or play time. Zoom still works. Turning it off preserves the current direction; choosing another direction or locating an object also releases tracking.
播放、暂停或切换正向与反向。流速的“年/秒”表示每过一秒现实时间，模拟中经过多少: Play, pause, or switch between forward and reverse. “yr/s” means simulated years per real second; higher values run faster. Motion remains a model approximation.
在裸眼、暗适应和相机之间切换，并选择大气与晨昏条件。显示曝光越高画面越亮，但不等: Switch between eye, dark-adapted and camera responses, then choose atmosphere and daylight conditions. Display exposure brightens the view but is not a physical camera shutter time.

星云是由气体和尘埃组成的云状天体。这里展示的是观测照片中的发光云气与暗部结构。: A nebula is a cloud of gas and dust. This view shows glowing gas and dark structures from an observational photograph.
这是疏散星团：一群在空间中较松散聚集的恒星。照片也包含恒星周围的云气。: An open cluster is a loose group of stars. This photograph also includes surrounding nebulosity.
这是球状星团：大量恒星密集聚集，整体呈近似球形。: A globular cluster is a dense, roughly spherical collection of many stars.
这是银河系外的星系，由大量恒星、气体与尘埃组成。相机模式展示观测照片，其他感光模: A galaxy beyond the Milky Way, containing stars, gas and dust. Camera mode uses an observational photograph; other responses use a simplified outline.
这是银河系外的星系。画面中的位置与大小由目录参数和当前观察位置计算，轮廓是近似显: A galaxy beyond the Milky Way. Its direction and size are calculated from catalogue parameters and your position; the outline is approximate.
